title: Impact of water models on structure and dynamics of enzyme tunnels
authors: Sethi A; Agrawal N; Brezovsky J
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过MD模拟比较不同水模型对酶隧道结构动态的影响，对象为折叠酶蛋白而非无序蛋白，且不涉及PPI或互作机制建模，仅对水模型选择提供方法学参考，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Protein hydration plays a vital role in many biological functions and molecular simulations are frequently used to study the effect of protein hydration at the atomic level. However, the accuracy of these simulations has often been highly sensitive to the water model used, a phenomenon best known in the case of intrinsically disordered proteins. In the present study, we investigated the extent to which the choice of water model alters the behavior of complex networks of transport tunnels. Tunnels are essential because they allow substrates and products to access and exit the active sites of enzymes that are otherwise deeply embedded within the protein structure. The ability of these tunnels to regulate access directly affects enzyme efficiency and selectivity, making their study crucial for understanding enzyme function and inhibition at a mechanistic level. By performing all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of the wild-type haloalkane dehalogenase LinBWT and its two variants, LinB32 and LinB86, with synthetically engineered tunnel networks in TIP3P and OPC water models, we investigated the effects of these models on the overall tunnel topology. We also analyzed the properties of the main tunnels, such as their conformation, bottleneck dimensions, sampling efficiency, and duration of the tunnel opening. Our data demonstrate that all three proteins exhibited similar conformational behavior in both water models and differed in the geometrical characteristics of their auxiliary tunnels, in line with experimental observations. Interestingly, the results indicate that the stability of the open tunnels is sensitive to the water model and the system under question. Our findings suggest that the 3-point TIP3P model can provide comparable inference on the overall topology of the networks of primary tunnels and their geometry, and thus may be a desirable choice when computational resources are limited or when compatibility issues impede usage of OPC with certain protein force fields. However, when a more thorough investigation is performed, such as the calculation of ligand unbinding rates via such tunnel networks, where precision and intricate details are paramount, the more costly 4-point OPC model would be more suited.

abstract_zh:
摘要

蛋白质水合作用在许多生物功能中扮演着至关重要的角色，分子模拟常被用于在原子层面研究蛋白质水合作用的影响。然而，这些模拟的准确性往往高度依赖于所使用的水模型，这一现象在固有无序蛋白质中最为人所知。在本研究中，我们探讨了水模型的选择在多大程度上改变复杂运输隧道网络的行为。隧道至关重要，因为它们允许底物和产物进入并离开酶的活性位点，而这些位点通常深埋于蛋白质结构内部。这些隧道调节通道的能力直接影响酶的效率和选择性，因此对其研究对于在机制层面理解酶功能和抑制至关重要。通过对野生型卤烷脱卤酶LinBWT及其两个变体LinB32和LinB86（具有合成工程改造的隧道网络）在TIP3P和OPC水模型中进行全原子分子动力学模拟，我们研究了这些模型对整体隧道拓扑结构的影响。我们还分析了主要隧道的特性，如其构象、瓶颈尺寸、采样效率以及隧道开启的持续时间。我们的数据表明，所有三种蛋白质在两种水模型下均表现出相似的构象行为，并在辅助隧道的几何特征上存在差异，这与实验观察结果一致。有趣的是，结果表明开放隧道的稳定性对水模型和所研究的系统敏感。我们的发现表明，3点TIP3P模型能够对主要隧道网络的整体拓扑结构及其几何形状提供可比较的推断，因此在计算资源有限或兼容性问题阻碍OPC与某些蛋白质力场配合使用时，可能是一个理想的选择。然而，当进行更深入的研究时，例如通过此类隧道网络计算配体解离速率，其中精度和复杂细节至关重要，则更昂贵的4点OPC模型更为适合。
